principle: 三晨星、光譜、策展集各自擁有獨立 corpus/store、獨立 admission/selection logic、獨立 public projection。共用的只有底層 content identity resolver 與站級能力；不得建立 universal editorial feed。

threeMorningStars.input: eligible content may come from any site surface but does not enter until selected

spectrum.input: works/projects/content admitted specifically by Spectrum rules
spectrum.output: Spectrum corpus with its own relational structure

overlapPolicy: If the same underlying content is independently selected by two systems, both stores reference the same canonical identity. No editorial membership is inherited across systems.
layoutConsequence: Future layout adapters must read three different stores. Visual coherence may be shared, information architecture may not be collapsed.
next: Normalize each real corpus independently: Spectrum first around existing works; Curated Sets by actual sets; Three Morning Stars only from authoritative selections.
